content.title: West Bengal Higher Education Minister Suggests Indian Attire for University Convocation
content.caption: West Bengal Higher Education Minister Jagannath Chattopadhyay suggests universities to adopt Indian attire such as Uttariya and handloom fabrics during convocation ceremonies.

slides.heading: West Bengal Higher Education Minister Suggests Indian Attire for University
slides.text: West Bengal Higher Education Minister Jagannath Chattopadhyay suggests universities to adopt Indian attire such as Uttariya and handloom fabrics during convocation ceremonies.
slides.image_search_query: West Bengal Higher Education Minister Jagannath Chattopadhyay

slides.heading: Context
slides.text: The West Bengal Higher Education Department has advised all State-aided universities to adopt Indian attire such as Uttariya and clothes made of handloom fabric during convocation ceremonies.

slides.heading: Details
slides.text: The development also came days after the Jalpaiguri Government Engineering College replaced the conventional academic gown with a traditional Uttariya.
